events.title_original: The beautiful, shocking work of artist Hoda Afshar: ‘I don’t take freedom of speech for granted’
events.summary: Afshar’s experiences as a young woman in Iran have shaped her artistic career in Australia, focusing her eye on the humanity within inhumane systems     Get our weekend culture and lifestyle email     When Hoda Afshar was a teenager, coming of age in theocratic and authoritarian Iran in the 1990s, she and her friends were repeatedly arrested and physically punished by the “morality police”, for wearing their hijabs incorrectly in public and for attending underground parties. “They used to put a few of us in small solitary confinement cells together for a night or two, it was very common for my generation to experience that,” she says.  （原文待翻译）
